claims: An estimated 0.9% growth in national home prices is projected through 2026.
As of January 2026, the median existing home sales price was roughly $396,800.
Home price growth is highest in the Northeast and Midwest.
There is a 9.7-month supply of new homes.
The median sale price in Virginia was $425,000 in 2026.
The median days on the market in Virginia increased by 20% year-over-year.
There were approximately 28,250 homes for sale in Virginia in February 2026.
The number of homes for sale in Virginia in February 2026 is a 7% increase from the previous year.
Property taxes have risen over 31% since 2019.
